title: NZ MBIE Determination 2026/036 (comparative): as-built modular dwelling, multi-clause compliance review (45 pages)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Gore District Council (foundations and site services) and Invercargill City Council (modules); comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; E2/AS1 third edition, amendment 10 and G9/VM1 first edition, amendment 7 as cited
source_url_note: Building CodeHub resource page for the same MBIE determination (Information provider: MBIE); the building.govt.nz determination page is WAF-blocked for this worker.

facts.text: The matter is the compliance of some elements of the as-built work with Building Code clauses B1, B2, E1, E2, E3 and G9.
The modular dwelling was constructed partly off-site and partly on the owners' property under two separate building consents granted by two authorities.
The dwelling sits on 53 driven timber piles; the approved plans show 32 of them as cantilever piles for sub-floor bracing.
The as-built piles differ from the layout in the approved plans, with some piles out of plumb by up to 60 mm per metre.
Photos show gaps of 1-2 mm between vinyl tiles in the bathrooms.
